lines.text: Six a.m. The alarm. And the first thought: I don't want to.
I don't want to get up! I don't want to work! Not again!
Bills. Emails. Meetings. Every day feels like the last one.
And sometimes you wonder: What is all of this for?
Ten thousand years ago, people had other problems. Hunger. Cold. Predators.
They would have given anything for a warm bed.
And out there, planets keep circling where nobody feels anything at all.
But you? You get to be angry! You get to be happy! You get to laugh with friends until it hurts!
Maybe it's okay not to feel like it today.
Just get up. One day at a time!
